title: The Great Escape.
deck: Bottom at Christmas. Safe when it mattered.
body: Albion began the final day of 2004/05 bottom of the Premier League. They needed to beat Portsmouth and depend on results elsewhere. After a goalless first half, Geoff Horsfield and Kieran Richardson scored the goals that gave Bryan Robson’s team a chance.

Norwich and Southampton lost, while Crystal Palace drew at Charlton. Albion survived, becoming the first Premier League side to stay up after being bottom at Christmas. It was a victory made meaningful by three other matches, and a final whistle followed by a wait for confirmation.
